title: metrics.json
description: Output of the `eval` service, written to ${LIBRARY_RESULTS_DIR}/metrics.json and committed as results/metrics.json. Metric definitions are in runtime.md. Exactly one system has served = true.

contract_version.description: Content of contract/VERSION the project was built against.

queries_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes of the file at LIBRARY_QUERIES_PATH.

corpus_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes of the file at LIBRARY_CORPUS_PATH.

systems.description: Every retrieval system evaluated, keyed by a name the candidate chooses.

platform.description: OS and CPU architecture eval ran on, as Docker names them, for example linux/amd64 or linux/arm64. Absent means linux/amd64.

timings.description: Optional timing measurements; free form and never compared.

served.description: true for the one system that GET /search serves.

rankings.description: For every query_id of the queries file, the ranked work_keys (best first, at most 100, no repeats).
